issues.issue: Whether the claimant's identity and account of the car-jacking and threats are credible
issues.applicant_position: Car-jacking and friend's death occurred; parents were threatened; he fears return to Mexico.
issues.result_text: Claimant not credible on identity, Mexican experience or car-jacking; account rejected.

issues.issue: Whether the claim should be assessed under section 96 (particular social group)
issues.applicant_position: Claim brought under section 96 as well as section 97.
issues.result_text: Counsel confined the claim to section 97(1)(b), so section 96 was not analyzed.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant would face risk to life or cruel treatment in Mexico (section 97)
issues.applicant_position: Threats from the car-jacker and against his parents show risk to life in Mexico.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not establish it is more likely than not he would face risk to life or cruel treatment.
